name: Setup New Computer
description: Download, install, and verify the software listed in a Markdown setup manifest.
promptScaffold: Set up the current computer from the supplied Markdown manifest. Read every requested application, version, component, install location, and configuration note before changing the machine. Download and install the listed software, honor the specified destinations, verify every result, and report anything requiring user approval or manual action.

options.label: Markdown document
options.prompt: The computer setup manifest is this Markdown file: {value} — read it and install the listed software at the specified locations.
